text:
maria.partners: Starting a CloudX marketplace hookup thread. They support per-minute pulses and an hourly rollup export. Primary concerns: canonical event_id, HMAC signature header, timezone handling, entitlement mapping (sku vs ent_id), and a safe backfill policy. Posting sample and a proposed ops plan.

ryan.ops: quick checklist: can they include an event_id? if not we should define a canonical id. also what does their retry/backoff look like? retries can cause duplicates.

maria.partners: CloudX confirmed older agents don't emit event_id. Newer fleet can include it. Their retry policy: exponential with jitter, up to 5 attempts within ~10 minutes.

devon.eng: technical notes:
- ingestion: minute pulses will arrive in bursts. current shard scheme (customer+hour) will hotspot. Proposal: write to a minute-tier buffer topic keyed by customer+minute then asynchronously roll up into our hourly ledger.
- dedupe: prefer partner-supplied event_id. if missing, compute id = sha256(tenant + sku + timestamp_iso). store original raw payload for audit.
- signature: CloudX sends header `X-CX-Signature: sha256=HEX`. They HMAC over raw request body with shared secret. Important: their library may compact whitespace; verify using raw bytes and test vectors.

devon.eng: sample payload from CloudX (sanitized):
```json
{
  "tenant": "acme-corp",
  "sku": "rwi-small-embed",
  "usage": [{"ts": "2026-03-22T23:59:00-08:00","units":1}],
  "ent_id": null,
  "signature": "sha256=..."
}
```

lia.product: mapping and economics: we should have a mapping table: cloudx.sku -> redwood.sku + pricing_tier. For missing ent_id we will infer and tag with `provenance=inferred_from_sku`. Inferred records must not be auto-credited in backfills without a manual sign-off.

ryan.ops: reconciliation approach: run a 72h shadow ingest into staging (no ledger writes). Request CloudX hourly rollups for same window. Run a daily reconcile job that compares our hourly rollups vs theirs and emits a delta report. For deltas > 0.2% or > 1000 units create a P1 alert/ticket.

maria.partners: CloudX asked about timezone canonicalization. They send ISO8601 with offsets. We should normalize to UTC on ingest and keep original string in raw_event.

devon.eng: agreed. store both original_timestamp and event_time_utc. Keep timezone offset preserved for troubleshooting. Also add a metric: percent of events with non-zero offset (to ensure we see mixed timezone devices).

lia.product: tests and docs: update integration README to include signature snippet, sample payloads (with event_id present and absent), mapping CSV, and a reconciliation playbook with thresholds. Also include a playbook for manual credits: who signs off and when.

sam-infra-bot: staging webhook endpoint deployed at https://staging-webhooks.internal.redwood/cloudx, helm release webhook-cloudx v1.2. Run `./scripts/push-sample --partner cloudx --file samples/cloudx-minute.json` to exercise.

ryan.ops: ops scripts: add verifier `tools/webhook-verify --secret $CLOUDX_SECRET --file samples/cloudx-minute.json` that prints expected header and compares. Also add a `replay` script to re-ingest a file into staging for backfill testing.

devon.eng: backfill policy proposal: if partner provides historical hourly rollups, run ingest->rollup->compare->delta pipeline. If delta <= threshold (0.2% and <= 1000 units) auto-apply ledger adjustments. If delta > threshold create manual review ticket prefilled with supporting raw events and partner rollup slice. Maintain audit trail for any ledger change.

maria.partners: I'll request the hourly exports for window 2026-03-18..2026-03-20 and confirm if their rollups are computed from minute pulses or approximated aggregates. That affects float rounding reconcilers.

lia.product: one more: how do we handle partial entitlements? cloudx can send usage tied to a SKU that maps to multiple internal plans (e.g., usage split across add-on and base). We need clear attribution rules in mapping doc.

devon.eng: mapping doc should include a deterministic rule and a lookup for overrides per tenant. If mapping ambiguous, mark event as `needs_mapping_review` and route to partners team.

ryan.ops: operational extras: record `inferred_ent_id_pct` and `daily_reconciliation_mismatch_pct` in our ops dashboard. add a runbook entry: immediate mitigation steps (shadow toggle, pause ingest from partner, manual credit process).

maria.partners: action items: @devon.eng implement minute buffer + dedupe + provenance flag in staging; @ryan.ops add verifier and replay scripts; @lia.product author mapping CSV and reconciliation playbook; I'll follow up with CloudX for event_id adoption and export. I'll post CloudX export here when available.

sam-infra-bot: scheduled deploy: webhook-cloudx -> staging at 2026-03-23T18:30:00Z, rolling 2 pods.

maria.partners: thanks all. Closing thread after we attach CloudX export and run first 72h shadow.
